findings.claim: 20-F 風險因子載明：Arm 受多司法管轄區反壟斷法規約束，過去曾遭反壟斷主管機關調查；Qualcomm 訴訟進行中，Qualcomm 占 FY2026 營收 9%。
findings.excerpt: Further, we are subject to antitrust laws and regulations in multiple jurisdictions, which could and has from time to time subjected us to investigations by antitrust regulators.

findings.claim: Bloomberg 報導 FTC 調查 Arm 授權行為是否試圖壟斷部分晶片市場，並要求 Arm 保存文件；Arm 否認反競爭指控，尚無正式指控。
findings.source: Bloomberg Law: Arm Is Said to Face US Antitrust Probe Over Chip Technology
findings.excerpt: investigation by the US Federal Trade Commission over the UK company’s licensing of its semiconductor technology, part of ongoing global scrutiny of the business, people familiar with the matter said.
